The API runs in the app. Annotations, the KSP processor, and the Gradle plugin handle declarations, generation, and build integration. Do not add the build plugin as an app runtime dependency.
Export one record as PDF, Excel, and Word with profiles, signature images, templates, and watermarks. Verify fonts, Office readers, and printing in the host.

Google sign-in and Firebase Auth require host OAuth, package, and signing configuration. Billing requires Play products and test accounts. Review prompts are subject to Play quotas. No ads, analytics, or host Pro policy are included.
The host supplies endpoints, certificates, and authentication. Do not embed real credentials. Request LAN permissions only for actual local access.
The host selects files and grants access. Configure servers, SAF directory permissions, or peers for the selected workflow. Foreground history is not a reliable background queue.
